request.style: English, female soulful solo voice with gentle choir, piano, acoustic guitar, cello, soft drums, warm and solemn mood, 85 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Prophets came down to Antioch that day
One named Agabus stood up to pray
By the Spirit he pointed ahead
A severe famine coming instead
This happened in the days of Claudius
The disciples sent relief to Judea

[Chorus]
The Spirit spoke through a prophet's voice
A warning of hunger a world-wide choice
Bound in the belt is the coming fate
To hand him over is the Gentile gate

[Verse]
After several days a prophet arrived
From Judea to where they had lived
He took Paul's belt in his hand
And tied his own feet in the sand
He said the Holy Spirit declares
The Jews will bind him in their squares

[Chorus]
The Spirit spoke through a prophet's voice
A warning of hunger a world-wide choice
Bound in the belt is the coming fate
To hand him over is the Gentile gate

[Verse]
We begged him not to go up there
To break his heart with our tears and care
But Paul said I am ready to be bound
Even to die in the holy ground
For the name of the Lord Jesus Christ
This is my path and my holy enlist

[Outro]
The Lord's will be done we said in the end
The prophet's word is the promise to send
